name: What is the difference between a paint color consultation and a full interior design service?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a paint color consultation and a full interior design service?

acceptedAnswer.text: A paint color consultation focuses specifically on selecting paint colors and finishes to achieve a desired aesthetic. A full interior design service, conversely, encompasses a broader range of elements including space planning, furniture selection, lighting, textiles, and accessories, in addition to color. While a consultation can be a part of design, it's a more specialized and streamlined service.
acceptedAnswer.description: A paint color consultation focuses solely on selecting paint colors. Full interior design is a broader service, including space planning, furniture, lighting, and accessories.
